title: AI models achieve 14% PPA improvements on AMD flagship GPU IP
summary: AI models achieved up to 14% power, performance, and area (PPA) circuit optimizations by rewriting RTL code for AMD's flagship GPU IP over five months. Anthropic demonstrated rapid three-day low-level kernel migration on the Instinct MI355X platform, where manual kernel porting requires 6 to 12 months of engineering effort.
research_notes:
Deploy AI workloads to AMD Instinct MI355X accelerators by utilizing automated model agents to port and compile low-level compute kernels for prompt processing.

Verify AI-synthesized RTL modifications on GPU architecture against functional testbenches using automated EDA simulation workflows before committing layouts to silicon production.
